_note: Axiom provider profile for the IDP baseline (checklist worksheet). Endpoint paths and capabilities were taken from a live isolated Axiom (OIDC discovery and RFC 8414 metadata, 2026-10-03) and the source; {issuer} is the deployment's configured issuer URL. Credentials are references to protected material only, never values.

endpoints.userinfo: {issuer}/oauth/userinfo (any session-backed access token of this issuer with openid; software tokens refused)

refresh_token.rotation: every use; reuse withdraws the family

urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-e.actor_token: not accepted (the actor is the authenticated workload)

access_token.audience: exactly one: the application audience (or the exchange target)

refresh_token.family_lifetime: refresh TTL counted from sign-in (no sliding extension)

tokens.scope_policy: business scopes are issued to a workforce person only where the person holds that application permission (narrowed, response reports the issued scope); customers receive what the customer-facing client offers and, if required, what they consent to

lifetimes.interactive_access_token: iam.oauth2.interactive-access-token.ttl (default PT1H, max iam.oauth2.interactive-access-token.max-ttl PT1H); per-client accessTokenTtlSeconds >= 60
lifetimes.refresh_token: iam.oauth2.refresh-token.ttl (default PT8H, max P30D); per-client refreshTokenTtlSeconds
lifetimes.token_exchange: iam.oauth2.token-exchange.ttl (default PT5M, max PT10M) and never beyond the subject token

status_and_revocation.introspection: authenticated (client_secret_basic or private_key_jwt); same-tenant callers only; other tenants learn {active:false}; no server-side cache
status_and_revocation.revocation: RFC 7009; revoking an access or refresh token ends that login's session, refresh family and exchanged descendants for online checks
status_and_revocation.logout: OIDC RP-Initiated Logout 1.0, form POST with id_token_hint; ends the named login (session, refresh family, descendants) and the browser session
status_and_revocation.offline_residual_window: until exp of each already-issued JWT

workforce.directory: SCIM 2.0 /scim/v2 or management API /users, /teams, application memberships/roles

customer.directory: management API /admin/tenants/{t}/ciam/customers; verification by the customer (delivery provider required outside loopback demos)
customer.consent: standard OAuth consent page when the client requires it; self-service list/withdraw at /ciam/tenants/{t}/customers/{c}/oauth-consents

provider_specific_setup_adapter.workload_registration_and_exchange_edges: /admin/tenants/{t}/ciam/agent-workloads, /admin/tenants/{t}/agent-exchange/{brokers,routes} (historical path names; generic workloads and edges)

conditional_profiles.IDP-14_external_assertion: not selected (jwt-bearer grant and federation assertions refused)
conditional_profiles.IDP-15_assurance: partial: password-level acr/amr/auth_time asserted and preserved; acr_values/max_age enforcement and MFA not available
